primary_thesis: Migrate the completed A100-40GB pipeline to H100 (94/141GB) and use the headroom on the three A100-era ceilings: (1) contrastive negatives capped at ~31 (in-batch only, no all_gather, moco=0) -> scale true per-step batch to 128-256; (2) Stage-0 undertrained (bs=8/40GB, 40K of ~117K steps) -> finish it; (3) 70M cap -> port v2 arch to 150M. Plus multi-source CXR data (IU-Xray excluded) for the intrinsic Indiana gap. Clean per-lever attribution held throughout.

2026-07-12: ROOT CAUSE FOUND (Phase-5 collapse). Evidence (diag_stage0_150m.sh tfevents + authoritative eval): val/loss 4.27 @ step666 (healthy, LR mid-warmup ~4e-4) -> 7.05 @ step3333 -> FLAT 7.05 for 100k steps (= unigram-entropy collapse / representation collapse). Collapse coincides EXACTLY with LR ramping to full 6.0e-4. Authoritative evaluate_lm.py PPL=1151.84 (loss 7.049) confirms it's real, not a metric artifact. CAUSE: generic train_stage0_h100.sh HARDCODED 70M values (LR=6.0e-4, warmup=1000) that overrode the 150M config's stability-tuned LR=4.0e-4/warmup=2000 -> too hot + too short warmup -> larger model collapsed. EXONERATED by evidence: arch (reached val 4.27 so fwd/bwd/grads work), gradient checkpointing (was learning), LR schedule shape (warmup/stable/decay correct). FIX: made LR/WARMUP env-overridable in train_stage0_h100.sh; train_stage0_150m_h100.sh now exports LR=4.0e-4 WARMUP=2000. NEXT (verify before 3-day commit — this is also the skipped 2G smoke): short smoke MAX_STEPS=6000 EXPERIMENT=..._lr4e4_smoke; confirm val/loss keeps DESCENDING past warmup (not collapse to 7.05). If stable -> full run; if still collapses -> drop LR=2.0e-4 / warmup=3000.

2026-07-14: FULL RUN COLLAPSED LATER (job 2332674, LR=4e-4). Trained HEALTHILY to step ~23660 (val PPL 18.75, descending, on track) then CATASTROPHIC COLLAPSE at ~step 24000 -> val PPL ~1170 (dead unigram entropy) held from step 25k-40k. Precursor recoverable wobbles at steps ~11k and ~14k (val PPL spiked to 30/86 then recovered). LR held constant 4e-4 (not the cause this time). grad_norm low (0.1-0.7) at sampled points incl post-collapse. => 150M is INTRINSICALLY UNSTABLE with this recipe: 70M stable@6e-4; 150M collapsed @3k(6e-4) and @24k(4e-4) — lower LR only DELAYS collapse. Smoke (6k steps) too short to catch it. ACTION: killed run. DEBUG (systematic, no blind relaunch): scripts/diag_collapse.sh dumps dense grad_norm/loss/beta2 over steps 20k-27k to tell spike-driven (->grad clip/beta2) vs gradual (->LR). Suspects: (a) LR still too hot for sustained 150M; (b) beta2 down-anneal 0.999->0.974 reduces optimizer smoothing late; (c) bf16 blowup in mLSTM exponential gates. Best pre-collapse ckpt ~step22000 = PPL ~19 (> 15.62 floor, unusable for gate). Phase 6 still blocked on a STABLE Stage-0.

2026-07-14: ROOT CAUSE of the step-24k collapse = gradient SPIKE + too-loose clip. Dense tfevents (diag_collapse.sh, steps 20k-27k): grad_norm steady ~0.23 then step 24749 = 1.589 (~7x); at that exact step ce_loss 2.97->6.01->7.04 and stayed dead. adam_beta2 FLAT 0.999 (anneal not started) and LR FLAT 4e-4 => both RULED OUT. Clip IS active (lightning_module.py:232-244 on_before_optimizer_step, clip_grad_norm_ returns PRE-clip norm) but max_norm=1.0 is ~4x the 0.23 baseline — too loose; the clipped-to-1.0 spike still collapsed the fragile 150M mLSTM. FIX (minimal, one var): gradient_clip_val 1.0->0.5 (GRAD_CLIP env; 150m wrapper sets 0.5). LR/warmup/beta2 UNCHANGED (training was healthy: PPL 18.75 @23.6k). VERIFY: full run w/ clip=0.5, monitor PAST step ~30k (previous collapse 24.7k) via monitor_stage0.sh; kill early if it collapses. If 0.5 still collapses -> clip 0.3 + consider grad-norm step-skipping. Phase 6 still gated on a stable full Stage-0 (PPL <=15.62 floor; was on track pre-collapse).

2026-07-16: CLIP 0.5 ALSO ONLY DELAYED (job 2339727, gradient_clip_val=0.5 confirmed). Healthy descent to val PPL 17.88 @ step 26994 then COLLAPSE to 1174 @ ~step 28000, dead through step 54k. Pattern now 3-for-3: LR6e-4->collapse@3k, LR4e-4->@24k, LR4e-4+clip0.5->@28k. Magnitude mitigations (LR, clip) only SHRINK the bad spike update -> delay, never prevent. Per systematic-debugging (3+ fixes fail => question approach, don't keep tweaking magnitudes). Model is intrinsically spike-fragile at 150M (70M was stable @6e-4/clip1.0). Loss stays FINITE 7.05 post-collapse (representation collapse to unigram, NOT NaN) => a bad-but-finite update tips weights into a dead attractor. RECOMMENDED real fix that PREVENTS (not delays): gradient-spike STEP-SKIPPING in on_before_optimizer_step (skip/zero the optimizer step when grad_norm > ~1.0, i.e. ~4x the 0.23 baseline) — standard large-model remedy (applies ZERO update on anomalous steps vs clip's bounded-but-still-bad update). Alternatives: fp32 mLSTM exponential gates (bf16 overflow?); shorter LR plateau/cosine decay. AWAITING user decision before code change to shared lightning_module.py. Best pre-collapse ckpt ~step27k = PPL ~17.9.

2026-07-16: NUMERICAL ROOT FIX (user chose fp32 route). Audit found TWO bf16-unsafe hotspots causing the grad spikes: (1) PRIMARY — Mamba selective_scan_parallel runs entirely in bf16 and divides Bx by cumulative decay A_cum clamped to 1e-8 (scan_interface.py) -> underflow division = huge gradients (9/12 layers are mamba; ref Mamba keeps SSM scan in fp32). (2) mLSTM exp gate: gate_soft_cap=15 -> exp(i_logit) up to exp(15)=3.3M in bf16 (imprecise, large local grad). FIX: scan_interface.selective_scan now upcasts x/dt/A/B/C/D to fp32, runs scan, casts back; mlstm_block computes exp gate in fp32 then casts back. Local: forward+backward finite (fp32 AND bf16-autocast); 38 layer/parity tests pass (1 pre-existing unrelated failure test_hybrid_layer stale API). Kept clip=0.5 as backstop, LR 4e-4/warmup 2000 unchanged. VERIFY: full run + monitor PAST step 30k (clears both 24k & 28k collapse points). If it still collapses -> fall back to grad-spike step-skipping. Phase 6 still gated on a stable full Stage-0.
